summary: The proposed change aims to address an overflow issue in the fowlkes_mallows_score function but may introduce numerical instability and lacks additional testing.

issues.description: The proposed change uses np.sqrt(tk / pk) * np.sqrt(tk / qk) which can lead to numerical instability if tk, pk, or qk are very small or zero, potentially resulting in NaN values.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify the correctness of the new implementation, especially for edge cases where pk or qk might be large or small.
